POST /v3/uploads

Creates a document from a single request body. Send the file as application/octet-stream and set X-Fernhollow-Filename. Maximum payload: 50 MB. Larger bodies are rejected with 413 Payload Too Large.

Returns 201 with the document id and a checksum. Uploads are processed asynchronously; poll GET /v3/documents/{id} for status.

POST /v3/uploads

Creates a document from a single request body. Send the file as application/octet-stream and set X-Fernhollow-Filename. Maximum payload: 50 MB. Larger bodies are rejected with 413 Payload Too Large.

Returns 201 with the document id and a checksum. Uploads are processed asynchronously; poll GET /v3/documents/{id} for status.

POST /v2/upload

Accepts multipart/form-data with a single file field. Maximum file size: 25 MB. The response includes a job_id; the document is not available until the job reports done.

This endpoint is kept for existing integrations. New integrations should use the v3 Uploads endpoint.

POST /v2/upload

Accepts multipart/form-data with a single file field, up to 25 MB. The response includes a job_id; the document is not available until the job reports done.

This endpoint is kept for existing integrations. New integrations should use the v3 Uploads endpoint.

Every workspace is pinned to one region when it is created, and documents never leave it. Set region in the POST /v3/workspaces body.

Available values: eu-west-1 (Dublin) and us-east-1 (Virginia). The region cannot be changed later; to move, create a new workspace and re-ingest.

Every workspace is pinned to one region when it is created, and documents never leave it. Set region in the POST /v3/workspaces body.

Available values: eu-west-1 (Dublin) and us-east-1 (Virginia). The region cannot be changed later; to move, create a new workspace and re-ingest.

POST /v3/keys/{key_id}/rotate

Issues a replacement secret for the key and returns it once. The previous secret keeps working for 24 hours after rotation so that deployments can roll over, then stops.

Keys are valid for 90 days from creation. Requires the keys:admin scope.

POST /v2/batch

Submits up to 500 document URLs for ingestion in one call. Each URL is fetched once; failures are listed in the batch report rather than retried. Poll GET /v2/batch/{batch_id} until state is complete.

POST /v2/batch

Deprecated. Requests are rejected after the sunset date; use /v3/jobs instead.

Submits up to 500 document URLs for ingestion in one call. Each URL is fetched once; failures are listed in the batch report rather than retried.

Limits apply per API key. Standard plans allow 600 requests per minute; Enterprise plans allow 3,000. Upload requests also count against a separate allowance of 2 GB transferred per minute.

When a limit is reached the API returns 429 with a Retry-After header in seconds.

- New /v3/jobs endpoint for bulk ingestion. Accepts URLs or presigned bucket paths, retries failed fetches up to three times.
- /v2/batch is now deprecated and will be removed after 31 December 2025. Migration guide linked from the jobs reference.
- Job reports can be streamed as NDJSON.

- Resumable uploads: start a session with POST /v3/upload-sessions and send parts of up to 16 MB each.
- Sessions expire after 24 hours of inactivity.
- SDKs for Python and Go pick resumable mode automatically for files over 100 MB.

- Single-request body ceiling raised from 50 MB to 200 MB on all plans.
- 413 responses now include max_bytes in the error body.
- Fixed checksums occasionally missing from 201 responses.

## Handling large files

Customers ingesting scanned archives often hit the upload limit before anything else. A single POST to /v3/uploads tops out at 50 MB, so anything bigger needs splitting before it reaches us. We usually recommend that they split PDFs by chapter on their side, which has the side benefit of better search results later.

If splitting isn't an option, raise it with the account team and we can look at a bulk import through the jobs endpoint instead.

## Handling large files

Customers ingesting scanned archives often hit the upload limit before anything else. A single POST to /v3/uploads tops out at 50 MB, so anything bigger needs splitting before it reaches us. We usually recommend that they split PDFs by chapter on their side, which has the side benefit of better search results later.

If splitting isn't an option, raise it with the account team and we can look at a bulk import through the jobs endpoint instead.

## Data residency FAQ

**Where is customer data stored?** In the region chosen for the workspace. We currently offer the EU (Ireland) and the US (Virginia).

**Can a customer use more than one region?** Yes, by running one workspace per region. Billing is combined at the organisation level.

**Do backups leave the region?** No. Backups are kept in a second availability zone within the same region.

## Credential lifetime policy

Following the July security review, the lifetime of newly issued API credentials has been shortened from 90 to 60 days. Existing credentials keep their original expiry date and are not affected until they are next rotated.

Customers get a reminder email 14 days before expiry. Support should point anyone asking about automated rotation to the rotate endpoint rather than suggesting they create new keys.

Agent (Priya): Hi, that's the payload cap, it's 50 MB per request at the moment. You can either split the file or use the new resumable upload sessions, which take the file in parts. Closing for now, reopen if you get stuck.

Customer: we still submit nightly loads with /v2/batch. is that ok long term or do we need to change anything?

Agent (Tom): Hi, /v2/batch is still supported and nothing is changing on it right now. We'll give plenty of notice before any change. Thanks!

Customer: our legal team need data kept in Australia. Can we get a workspace there? we're blocked on signing until this is sorted

Agent (Sam): Thanks for flagging. We don't have an Australian region today, it's on the roadmap but I can't give a date. I've passed this to your account manager.

Customer: whats the biggest file we can push through /v3/uploads in one go? want to size our exports

Agent (Priya): Hi! It's 50 MB per request. For anything bigger the upload sessions endpoint takes files in 16 MB parts, so there's no practical ceiling there.

## Choosing a workspace region

During onboarding, ask the customer where their data has to live before the first workspace is created, because it cannot be moved afterwards. The two options are Dublin (eu-west-1) and Virginia (us-east-1). Most UK and EU customers pick Dublin; if they are unsure, legal usually has an opinion.

Customer: how long do api keys last before they expire? and if we rotate does the old one die immediately, we have a few services sharing one

Agent (Jo): Keys last 90 days. When you rotate, the old secret keeps working for 24 hours, so you have a day to roll it out everywhere.

Customer: is there a cap on how many urls one /v2/batch call can take? planning our nightly job around it

Agent (Tom): 500 per call, and that hasn't changed. If you need more just send several batches, there's no limit on how many you run a night.
